shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g '"'!dist'"' -g '"'!build'"' | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,95p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'table|uikit|icons' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md'

/bin/bash -lc '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination TextInput Select Button Modal DropdownMenu Label Icon && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat tsconfig.json && ls -a'

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination TextInput Select Button Modal DropdownMenu Label Icon; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; cat tsconfig.json; ls -a'
/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/gravity-uikit-7.md && rg -n '"'^#|withTableSorting|withTableSelection'"' /tmp/gravity-uikit-7.md | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import urllib.request
u='https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt'
s=urllib.request.urlopen(u).read().decode()
open('/tmp/gravity-uikit-7.md','w').write(s)
PY
rg -n '"'^#.*(Table|Pagination|Button|TextInput|Select|Modal|DropdownMenu|Label)|withTableSorting|withTableSelection'"' /tmp/gravity-uikit-7.md | head -70
ls node_modules/@gravity-ui
cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from \"node:fs\"; const r=await fetch(\"https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt\");if("'!r.ok)throw Error(r.status);fs.writeFileSync("/tmp/gravity-uikit-7.md",await r.text());const i=await fetch("https://gravity-ui.com/icons");fs.writeFileSync("/tmp/gravity-icons.html",await i.text());'"' && rg -n '"'^#.*(Table|Pagination|Button|TextInput|Select|Modal|DropdownMenu|Label)|withTableSorting|withTableSelection'"' /tmp/gravity-uikit-7.md | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -230; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head -45; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "wc -c /tmp/gravity-uikit-7.md /tmp/gravity-icons.html; head -c 700 /tmp/gravity-uikit-7.md; rg -o 'Magnifier|Plus|ArrowDownToLine|ChevronDown|Bell|CircleQuestion|Persons|ArrowUpRight|Sliders|LayoutCells|Ellipsis|Xmark|ArrowRightFromSquare|Gear' /tmp/gravity-icons.html | sort -u; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -210; rg -n 'utility|positive|info|background|spacing' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -45; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -i 'table|pagination|textinput|modal|label|button|select' /tmp/gravity-uikit-7.md | head -65; rg -o 'magnifier|plus|arrow-down-to-line|chevron-down|bell|circle-question|persons|arrow-up-right|sliders|layout-cells|ellipsis|xmark|gear' /tmp/gravity-icons.html | sort -u; rg -n -- '--g-color-(base-utility|text-utility|line-utility|text-light-primary|base-float|base-background|line-generic)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/_light.scss | head -30; sed -n '132,168p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -155"

/bin/bash -lc "head -c 450 node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/metadata.json; head -30 node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts; rg -n 'Magnifier|Plus|ArrowDownToLine|ChevronDown|CircleQuestion|Bell|Persons|Sliders|LayoutCells|ArrowUpRight|Xmark|Envelope|CircleCheck|CirclePlus' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts; rg -o -- '--g-color-(base-utility["'^: ]*|text-utility[''^: ]*|line-utility[''^: ]*|text-light-primary|base-float[''^: ]*)'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -40; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -145; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts | head -100; cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -- '--g-(button|text-input|select|table|label)-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.css | head -65; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts | head -90; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ThemeProvider/useTheme.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'Moon|Sun|ChartColumn|ChartLine|Clock|CreditCard|TrashBin|CircleDashed|Building' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts; rg -n 'Tabs|TabProvider|TabList|Tab\\b' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Tabs/Tabs.d.ts | head -45; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Tabs/Tabs.d.ts | head -110; rg -n -- '--g-color-(text-complementary|base-neutral|line-generic-solid|base-simple-hover|text-secondary)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -10"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && rg -n -- '--g-color-base-generic-ultralight:|--g-color-text-positive-heavy:|--g-color-text-info-heavy:|--g-spacing-7:|--g-spacing-9:|--g-border-radius-l:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -18 && cat src/main.tsx && cat package.json"
